backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing feature changes, affected files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file listing high-level summaries of various frontend components and configuration files.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD schema for the site.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling the landing page sections and floating contact buttons.
frontend/src/components/common/IconBadge: Reusable icon badge component with size and style variants.
frontend/src/components/common/LogoWithB: Logo component rendering the service logo with padded backing and size options.
frontend/src/components/floating/Floatin: Floating WhatsApp and call buttons with premium styling.
frontend/src/components/landing/Appointm: Appointment form with validation, input fields, and WhatsApp booking link generation.
frontend/src/components/landing/AreasSer: Section listing Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar service areas with styled grid chips.
frontend/src/components/landing/Footer.t: Renders the landing page footer with brand info, quick links, and contact details including phone, address, and Google link.
frontend/src/components/landing/GoogleRe: Displays a Google reviews section with rating, review count, and a button linking to full Google reviews.
frontend/src/components/landing/Header.t: Implements the sticky top navigation bar with branding, menu links, and quick-access call, WhatsApp, and Instagram buttons.
frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx: Shows the main hero banner with background image, service highlights, and call‑to‑action buttons for booking, calling, and WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhot: Presents a grid of live cleaning work photos with optional labels, using Card and Badge components.
frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceC: Displays a banner highlighting service coverage areas with a header and coverage image.
frontend/src/components/landing/Services: Defines themed service cards and pricing details for sofa, carpet, chair, mattress, and AC cleaning, including a price calculator.
frontend/src/components/landing/SofaPric: Interactive UI component that calculates sofa cleaning cost based on size using a slider and displays contact options.
frontend/src/components/landing/WhyChoos: Renders a feature grid highlighting service benefits with icons and descriptive text.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, login state, and persisted identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS defining theme variables, dark mode palettes, and premium UI component styles.
frontend/src/lib/whatsappBooking.ts: Utility functions to format booking details into a message and generate a WhatsApp URL with encoded text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the main App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, shadows, and enabling plugins with support for custom palette variables.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s versioned state, including scope, architectural notes, known issues, and existing features for the marketing website. Captures conflicts such as AI-feature restrictions, language changes, UI updates, and asset requirements.
